rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Those guys brought out Walker Machines!
rows.display_text: 「Those guys brought out Walker Machines!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: What fools. This is like broadcasting their own crimes to the whole city.
rows.display_text:
「What fools. This is like broadcasting
their own crimes to the whole city.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: That's old news! This city's basically already under Este's control.
rows.display_text:
「That's old news! This city's basically
already under Este's control.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: With this much firepower on our side, even the police just look the other way.
rows.display_text:
「With this much firepower on our side,
even the police just look the other way.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Let me tell you, Este Corp's power doesn't stop here.
rows.display_text:
「Let me tell you, Este Corp's power
doesn't stop here.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Chiram devices and mobile suits are coming out too!
rows.display_text:
「Chiram devices and mobile suits are
coming out too!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: That's Este's pride and joy -- the guard system.
rows.display_text:
「That's Este's pride and joy -- the
guard system.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: A combat unit made of secondhand military machines rigged with autopilot systems.
rows.display_text:
「A combat unit made of secondhand
military machines rigged with autopilot
systems.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: B-but... isn't this a little much just to chase down two people!?
rows.display_text:
「B-but... isn't this a little much just to
chase down two people!?」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: It's a good opportunity, that's why. We're gonna show the whole city what Este Corp can do!
rows.display_text:
「It's a good opportunity, that's why.
We're gonna show the whole city what
Este Corp can do!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Mel... this is an emergency. Clearly, I have no choice but to fight in self-defense.
rows.display_text:
「Mel... this is an emergency. Clearly, I
have no choice but to fight in
self-defense.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Right! Get 'em, Roger!
rows.display_text: 「Right! Get 'em, Roger!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Very well...
rows.display_text: 「Very well...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Big O, showtime!
rows.display_text: 「Big O, showtime!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: It's not coming!
rows.display_text: 「It's not coming!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I suppose it's not as simple as it was back in Paradigm City...
rows.display_text:
「I suppose it's not as simple as it was
back in Paradigm City...」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: What was that! Just a bluff!?
rows.display_text: 「What was that! Just a bluff!?」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Don't try to scare us, you bastard!
rows.display_text: 「Don't try to scare us, you bastard!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: It's over! Darling, live on strong even without me!!
rows.display_text:
「It's over! Darling, live on strong even
without me!!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: No need to worry. I have someone who understands me.
rows.display_text:
「No need to worry. I have someone who
understands me.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: The Big O! Who's piloting it!?
rows.display_text: 「The Big O! Who's piloting it!?」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: It's me.
rows.display_text: 「It's me.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Thank you, Dorothy. I knew you'd come.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you, Dorothy. I knew you'd come.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: You went out on a job. So, just in case, I got things ready.
rows.display_text:
「You went out on a job. So, just in
case, I got things ready.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Respecting my way of doing things, while giving precise support.
rows.display_text:
「Respecting my way of doing things,
while giving precise support.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Not too close, not too far... You keep just the right distance.
rows.display_text:
「Not too close, not too far... You keep
just the right distance.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Sorry, boss. Making you look after Mel.
rows.display_text: 「Sorry, boss. Making you look after Mel.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Don't worry about it. As for me, I consider it a fortunate opportunity.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry about it. As for me, I
consider it a fortunate opportunity.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: My apologies to you too, Captain Lowen.
rows.display_text: 「My apologies to you too, Captain Lowen.」

rows.speaker: Lowen
rows.en: ...In my case, I got dragged along without even knowing why, though.
rows.display_text:
「...In my case, I got dragged along
without even knowing why, though.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Hurry up and get in, Roger. Big O is waiting too.
rows.display_text:
「Hurry up and get in, Roger. Big O is
waiting too.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Understood.
rows.display_text: 「Understood.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: W-what!? Something really did show up after all!
rows.display_text:
「W-what!? Something really did show up
after all!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Don't worry about it! There's only 3 of them! Take 'em down!
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry about it! There's only 3 of
them! Take 'em down!」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: That's not going to happen.
rows.display_text: 「That's not going to happen.」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: Dorothy contacted me. I'll back you up, Roger.
rows.display_text:
「Dorothy contacted me. I'll back you up,
Roger.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Sorry, everyone. For dragging you into this.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, everyone. For dragging you into
this.」

rows.speaker: Apollo
rows.en: Well... I figured it'd end up like this if you went out there.
rows.display_text:
「Well... I figured it'd end up like this if
you went out there.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Wait a second, Apollo! This is...
rows.display_text: 「Wait a second, Apollo! This is...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Mel.
rows.display_text: 「Mel.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Y-yeah...! Got it, Roger!
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah...! Got it, Roger!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: What was that signal about, Mel?
rows.display_text: 「What was that signal about, Mel?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: It's fine, it's fine. Don't worry about it, don't worry about it!
rows.display_text:
「It's fine, it's fine. Don't worry about
it, don't worry about it!」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Ah, I saw that on the UN! It's the New Earth Federation's special forces!!
rows.display_text:
「Ah, I saw that on the UN! It's the New
Earth Federation's special forces!!」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: This can't be...! The New Earth Federation has come to take over my city!
rows.display_text:
「This can't be...! The New Earth
Federation has come to take over my
city!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: That old man's been fooled by the UN too, spouting nonsense like that.
rows.display_text:
「That old man's been fooled by the UN
too, spouting nonsense like that.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Old man! We're not...
rows.display_text: 「Old man! We're not...」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: It's fine. Let people say whatever they want to say.
rows.display_text:
「It's fine. Let people say whatever they
want to say.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: We're $c. No matter what anyone says about us, that's just fine, isn't it?
rows.display_text:
「We're $c. No matter what anyone says
about us, that's just fine, isn't it?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Look at you, you get it, Mel.
rows.display_text: 「Look at you, you get it, Mel.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: That's about right.
rows.display_text: 「That's about right.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: We just do what we want to do, same as always.
rows.display_text:
「We just do what we want to do, same
as always.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Damn it! If it's come to this, we have no choice but to defeat them! Begin the attack!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! If it's come to this, we have
no choice but to defeat them! Begin the
attack!」

rows.speaker: Jamil
rows.en: All units, begin attack! Let's meet these thugs head-on!
rows.display_text:
「All units, begin attack! Let's meet
these thugs head-on!」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Since I'm already in the cockpit, I'll back you up today.
rows.display_text:
「Since I'm already in the cockpit, I'll
back you up today.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's awfully generous of you, Dorothy. Did something good happen?
rows.display_text:
「That's awfully generous of you,
Dorothy. Did something good happen?」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Not particularly...
rows.display_text: 「Not particularly...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Well, fine... I'll be counting on you, Dorothy.
rows.display_text:
「Well, fine... I'll be counting on you,
Dorothy.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Big O! Action!!
rows.display_text: 「Big O! Action!!」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Ah... aah... my army... My dream is over...!
rows.display_text:
「Ah... aah... my army... My dream is
over...!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Now that they've lost their backing of brute force, this is the end for Este Corp.
rows.display_text:
「Now that they've lost their backing of
brute force, this is the end for Este
Corp.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Regardless of the process and the methods, one of my two jobs is finished.
rows.display_text:
「Regardless of the process and the
methods, one of my two jobs is finished.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: One of two?
rows.display_text: 「One of two?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's right. I still have to take care of the other job.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. I still have to take care
of the other job.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Big O's in excellent shape today. I wonder if it's because Dorothy's riding along?
rows.display_text:
「Big O's in excellent shape today. I
wonder if it's because Dorothy's riding
along?」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: It's thanks to Norman's maintenance.
rows.display_text: 「It's thanks to Norman's maintenance.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That was a joke, meant to put you at ease -- you must be tense.
rows.display_text:
「That was a joke, meant to put you at
ease -- you must be tense.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Sounds like you're the one something good happened to.
rows.display_text:
「Sounds like you're the one something
good happened to.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: ...Sorry about this, Norman. Having you play bartender.
rows.display_text:
「...Sorry about this, Norman. Having you
play bartender.」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Please don't concern yourself. If I can be of service, feel free to ask for anything.
rows.display_text:
「Please don't concern yourself. If I can
be of service, feel free to ask for
anything.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Well, much obliged... I'm honored.
rows.display_text: 「Well, much obliged... I'm honored.」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Master Tex, would you care for another?
rows.display_text:
「Master Tex, would you care for
another?」

rows.speaker: Tex
rows.en: You're a splendid barman. The way you pour, the timing of your conversation -- all of it is exquisite.
rows.display_text:
「You're a splendid barman. The way you
pour, the timing of your conversation --
all of it is exquisite.」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: That's only because you all enjoy your drinks so much. It gives me all the more reason to put my skills to use.
rows.display_text:
「That's only because you all enjoy your
drinks so much. It gives me all the more
reason to put my skills to use.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: The Freeden's turned into a full-on bar, hasn't it?
rows.display_text:
「The Freeden's turned into a full-on
bar, hasn't it?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: For the record, we got Jamil's permission for this.
rows.display_text:
「For the record, we got Jamil's
permission for this.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Well... drinking in the middle of the day might be a bit of a problem, though.
rows.display_text:
「Well... drinking in the middle of the day
might be a bit of a problem, though.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Well then, Norman... I'll be heading out for a bit.
rows.display_text:
「Well then, Norman... I'll be heading out
for a bit.」

rows.speaker: Norman
rows.en: Please take care, Master Roger.
rows.display_text: 「Please take care, Master Roger.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Come on, Roger. Calling it quits after just one drink? That's kind of a bummer.
rows.display_text:
「Come on, Roger. Calling it quits after
just one drink? That's kind of a bummer.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Sorry. There's a small errand I need to take care of.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry. There's a small errand I need to
take care of.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Well then, if you'll excuse me.
rows.display_text: 「Well then, if you'll excuse me.」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Stylish guy, huh. Wearing a suit even in a place like this.
rows.display_text:
「Stylish guy, huh. Wearing a suit even in
a place like this.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: That's the only clothes Roger owns.
rows.display_text: 「That's the only clothes Roger owns.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Aren't you gonna ask where he's headed?
rows.display_text:
「Aren't you gonna ask where he's
headed?」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: There's no need for me to know.
rows.display_text: 「There's no need for me to know.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Wow, you really are cold, aren't you.
rows.display_text: 「Wow, you really are cold, aren't you.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Knowing Roger, he probably picked up a job or something.
rows.display_text:
「Knowing Roger, he probably picked up a
job or something.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: You never know. Could be a date.
rows.display_text: 「You never know. Could be a date.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: It's not out of the question. Mr. Negotiator's got a soft spot for women, believe it or not.
rows.display_text:
「It's not out of the question. Mr.
Negotiator's got a soft spot for women,
believe it or not.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Is that okay with you, Dorothy...!?
rows.display_text: 「Is that okay with you, Dorothy...!?」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: What is?
rows.display_text: 「What is?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: What do you mean, what -- Roger might have gone on a date.
rows.display_text:
「What do you mean, what -- Roger might
have gone on a date.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: It's none of my business.
rows.display_text: 「It's none of my business.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Dorothy...
rows.display_text: 「Dorothy...」

rows.speaker: Federation Soldier
rows.en: ...So, you'll take the job?
rows.display_text: 「...So, you'll take the job?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I have no intention of turning down a request from someone who shows courtesy and sincerity.
rows.display_text:
「I have no intention of turning down a
request from someone who shows courtesy
and sincerity.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Especially not when it's a request naming me specifically, trusting in my skill. I can hardly brush that aside.
rows.display_text:
「Especially not when it's a request
naming me specifically, trusting in my
skill. I can hardly brush that aside.」

rows.speaker: Federation Soldier
rows.en: Thank you very much, Roger Smith.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you very much, Roger Smith.」

rows.speaker: Federation Soldier
rows.en: Then I'll be waiting for good news.
rows.display_text: 「Then I'll be waiting for good news.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...A present for someone dear to him. Now that's a job worth putting my skills to use for. ...Now then.
rows.display_text:
「...A present for someone dear to him.
Now that's a job worth putting my skills
to use for. ...Now then.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Why don't you come on out now, Mel Beater?
rows.display_text:
「Why don't you come on out now, Mel
Beater?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Oh... you noticed?
rows.display_text: 「Oh... you noticed?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'm well accustomed to both tailing people and being tailed.
rows.display_text:
「I'm well accustomed to both tailing
people and being tailed.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: So... what business did you have following me?
rows.display_text:
「So... what business did you have
following me?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Um... well... that is... I thought maybe... you might be going on a date with someone, Roger...
rows.display_text:
「Um... well... that is... I thought maybe...
you might be going on a date with
someone, Roger...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It's true I'm about to go meet a woman.
rows.display_text:
「It's true I'm about to go meet a
woman.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Wha--!? Who is it!? How'd you two meet!? Are you planning to get married!?
rows.display_text:
「Wha--!? Who is it!? How'd you two
meet!? Are you planning to get married!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Very well, Mel. If you're that interested, I'll permit you to come along.
rows.display_text:
「Very well, Mel. If you're that
interested, I'll permit you to come along.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Huh... won't I be in the way?
rows.display_text: 「Huh... won't I be in the way?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: $F did Dorothy a favor once before. This is partly to repay that.
rows.display_text:
「$F did Dorothy a favor once before.
This is partly to repay that.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Besides, I make it a policy to treat women with care. Even if the woman in question is a child, I'll keep to that.
rows.display_text:
「Besides, I make it a policy to treat
women with care. Even if the woman in
question is a child, I'll keep to that.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Something about that rubs me the wrong way...!
rows.display_text:
「Something about that rubs me the wrong
way...!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Now then, let's be off. Visiting a woman's home is proper etiquette in the daytime.
rows.display_text:
「Now then, let's be off. Visiting a
woman's home is proper etiquette in the
daytime.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: ...So, where is this?
rows.display_text: 「...So, where is this?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: As you can see, it's a garden. My job is to get some of the flowers blooming here.
rows.display_text:
「As you can see, it's a garden. My job
is to get some of the flowers blooming
here.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: A job...? Then, the woman is...
rows.display_text: 「A job...? Then, the woman is...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The owner of this garden. Calling her a date would be putting it a bit differently than the truth.
rows.display_text:
「The owner of this garden. Calling her a
date would be putting it a bit differently
than the truth.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Oh, is that all... what a relief.
rows.display_text: 「Oh, is that all... what a relief.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: You seem quite interested in my relationships with women, but aren't you devoted only to $n?
rows.display_text:
「You seem quite interested in my
relationships with women, but aren't you
devoted only to $n?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: That's right! ...Were you hoping for something else, even a little?
rows.display_text:
「That's right! ...Were you hoping for
something else, even a little?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: If you were my type, perhaps.
rows.display_text: 「If you were my type, perhaps.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Argh... everything you say rubs me the wrong way! This time I was just butting in for Dorothy's sake.
rows.display_text:
「Argh... everything you say rubs me the
wrong way! This time I was just butting
in for Dorothy's sake.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: For Dorothy's sake? Now that's... what do you mean by that?
rows.display_text:
「For Dorothy's sake? Now that's... what
do you mean by that?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Huh...? I mean, Dorothy likes you, doesn't she?
rows.display_text:
「Huh...? I mean, Dorothy likes you,
doesn't she?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Huh?
rows.display_text: 「Huh?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: As a girl myself, I can tell. That sharp way of talking is just the flip side of affection.
rows.display_text:
「As a girl myself, I can tell. That sharp
way of talking is just the flip side of
affection.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I don't believe that's the case... For one thing, she's an android.
rows.display_text:
「I don't believe that's the case... For
one thing, she's an android.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: But Mome adores Kei to bits, and Dorothy has a heart too. It wouldn't be strange for her to fall for someone.
rows.display_text:
「But Mome adores Kei to bits, and
Dorothy has a heart too. It wouldn't be
strange for her to fall for someone.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'll grant that she has a heart. But that doesn't mean I know whether she possesses an emotion like love.
rows.display_text:
「I'll grant that she has a heart. But
that doesn't mean I know whether she
possesses an emotion like love.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Much less that it could possibly be directed at me -- I've never even considered such a thing.
rows.display_text:
「Much less that it could possibly be
directed at me -- I've never even
considered such a thing.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Honestly... you're just not honest with yourself.
rows.display_text:
「Honestly... you're just not honest with
yourself.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's enough chatting. My negotiation partner has arrived.
rows.display_text:
「That's enough chatting. My negotiation
partner has arrived.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Sorry to keep you waiting, Mr. Smith. I'm the owner of this garden.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Mr. Smith.
I'm the owner of this garden.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Roger will do just fine, Ms. Flores.
rows.display_text: 「Roger will do just fine, Ms. Flores.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: I understand you'd like some of this garden's flowers...
rows.display_text:
「I understand you'd like some of this
garden's flowers...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Yes... I've been asked by a certain person to negotiate on their behalf.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... I've been asked by a certain
person to negotiate on their behalf.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: What do you say? Would you be willing to part with the flowers he wants, at a fair price?
rows.display_text:
「What do you say? Would you be willing
to part with the flowers he wants, at a
fair price?」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: I'm afraid...
rows.display_text: 「I'm afraid...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: My client says he's prepared to offer a suitable amount, but...
rows.display_text:
「My client says he's prepared to offer a
suitable amount, but...」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: It's not a matter of money.
rows.display_text: 「It's not a matter of money.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: How do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「How do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: This garden has been a hobby of my family's since my grandfather's generation.
rows.display_text:
「This garden has been a hobby of my
family's since my grandfather's generation.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: During the Break the World, it nearly fell into ruin, but somehow I've managed to bring it back this far.
rows.display_text:
「During the Break the World, it nearly
fell into ruin, but somehow I've managed
to bring it back this far.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: These flowers are the same as life itself to me. I can't possibly hand them over as mere merchandise.
rows.display_text:
「These flowers are the same as life
itself to me. I can't possibly hand them
over as mere merchandise.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I understand. Then, I'll take my leave for today.
rows.display_text:
「I understand. Then, I'll take my leave
for today.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: He's just giving up and leaving!?
rows.display_text: （He's just giving up and leaving!?）

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I work as a negotiator, but...
rows.display_text: 「I work as a negotiator, but...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I don't choose my clients based on how much they're paying.
rows.display_text:
「I don't choose my clients based on how
much they're paying.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Are you saying that, for you, being a negotiator isn't about the money...?
rows.display_text:
「Are you saying that, for you, being a
negotiator isn't about the money...?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I have no wish to be crude toward someone who shares that same conviction. I'll come back another day.
rows.display_text:
「I have no wish to be crude toward
someone who shares that same conviction.
I'll come back another day.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Mind if we barge in, Ms. Flores?
rows.display_text: 「Mind if we barge in, Ms. Flores?」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: You're from Este Corp...!
rows.display_text: 「You're from Este Corp...!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: That's right. Este says he'd like an answer pretty soon now.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. Este says he'd like an
answer pretty soon now.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: So that's why we're here -- just running an errand.
rows.display_text:
「So that's why we're here -- just
running an errand.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: If it's about that, I've already declined formally. No matter how much money you offer, I have no intention of selling this land...!
rows.display_text:
「I've already declined formally. No
matter how much you offer, I have no
intention of selling this land...!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Can't hear ya.
rows.display_text: 「Can't hear ya.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: That's not the kind of answer Este wants to hear, sweetheart.
rows.display_text:
「That's not the kind of answer Este
wants to hear, sweetheart.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: You are...
rows.display_text: 「You are...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Committing intimidation in front of such beautiful flowers -- that's crude, even by low standards.
rows.display_text:
「Committing intimidation in front of such
beautiful flowers -- that's crude, even
by low standards.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Who the hell are you!? Some bodyguard she hired?
rows.display_text:
「Who the hell are you!? Some bodyguard
she hired?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'm not that, but I intend to treat anyone who lacks proper courtesy toward a woman accordingly.
rows.display_text:
「I'm not that, but I intend to treat
anyone who lacks proper courtesy toward
a woman accordingly.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Tch... can't go causing trouble out in the open. Let's pull out, guys.
rows.display_text:
「Tch... can't go causing trouble out in
the open. Let's pull out, guys.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Lucky you, pal. Today's your lucky day.
rows.display_text: 「Lucky you, pal. Today's your lucky day.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: But remember this, sweetheart. Este wants his answer, and soon.
rows.display_text:
「But remember this, sweetheart. Este
wants his answer, and soon.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: A beautiful garden and a land shark... Now, what should I do about this...
rows.display_text:
（A beautiful garden and a land shark...
Now, what should I do about this...）

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: ...Taking on a negotiation against a land shark? Pretty shrewd of you, Roger.
rows.display_text:
「...Taking on a negotiation against a
land shark? Pretty shrewd of you, Roger.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: What do you mean, Mel?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean, Mel?」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: If you take down the land shark now, I bet Ms. Flores will give you the flowers for sure. That'll wrap up the job perfectly.
rows.display_text:
「If you take down the land shark now, I
bet Ms. Flores gives you the flowers.
That wraps up the job perfectly.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's not my intention, though.
rows.display_text: 「That's not my intention, though.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Really?
rows.display_text: 「Really?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: This job and my first job are separate matters. That's why I took on her request properly, in exchange for actual payment.
rows.display_text:
「This job and my first job are separate
matters. That's why I took her request
properly, for actual payment.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I have no intention of turning my work into something that preys on someone's weakness.
rows.display_text:
「I have no intention of turning my work
into something that preys on someone's
weakness.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Hmm...

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Sorry to keep you waiting, Roger. I'm Este, the representative of this company.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Roger. I'm
Este, the representative of this company.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: It seems you run quite a wide-reaching real estate business.
rows.display_text:
「It seems you run quite a wide-reaching
real estate business.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Well, given the times we live in. You never know when land itself might simply vanish...
rows.display_text:
「Well, given the times we live in. You
never know when land itself might simply
vanish...」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: So you see, my buying up land is practically a charitable act, in a way.
rows.display_text:
「So you see, my buying up land is
practically a charitable act, in a way.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I see... So you've been stoking the anxieties unique to the multiverse to buy up land at outrageously low prices...
rows.display_text:
「I see... So you've been stoking the
anxieties unique to the multiverse to buy
up land at outrageously low prices...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: And for those who wouldn't comply, you've resorted to intimidation through violence.
rows.display_text:
「And for those who wouldn't comply,
you've resorted to intimidation through
violence.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Please don't say such slanderous things.
rows.display_text: 「Please don't say such slanderous things.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I didn't come here to debate your business practices.
rows.display_text:
「I didn't come here to debate your
business practices.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Let me be blunt. I want you to stop interfering with Ms. Flores's garden.
rows.display_text:
「Let me be blunt. I want you to stop
interfering with Ms. Flores's garden.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: I refuse. We're conducting business here too.
rows.display_text:
「I refuse. We're conducting business here
too.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: If you're going to get in the way of that, I have ways of dealing with it.
rows.display_text:
「If you're going to get in the way of
that, I have ways of dealing with it.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I've seen exactly what kind of man you are. I'll call that my takeaway from this.
rows.display_text:
「I've seen exactly what kind of man you
are. I'll call that my takeaway from this.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: I'll ask you to leave. Don't show your face here again.
rows.display_text:
「I'll ask you to leave. Don't show your
face here again.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...Understood. But I imagine we'll meet again.
rows.display_text:
「...Understood. But I imagine we'll meet
again.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: This city has a police force, after all, and public opinion as well.
rows.display_text:
「This city has a police force, after all,
and public opinion as well.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I'll use every means at my disposal, even those, to make your company change its ways.
rows.display_text:
「I'll use every means at my disposal,
even those, to make your company change
its ways.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Grr...

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Now then, I'll take my leave.
rows.display_text: 「Now then, I'll take my leave.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The sun's completely set, but let's get one more job done.
rows.display_text:
「The sun's completely set, but let's get
one more job done.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Are you gonna use Big O to take down that company?
rows.display_text:
「Are you gonna use Big O to take down
that company?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Forcing my point through violence would make me no different from that land shark. That's not what a negotiator does.
rows.display_text:
「Forcing my point through violence would
make me no different from that land
shark. That's not what a negotiator does.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: My power to fight lies in wit and words. Resorting to violent force is only for self-defense, or as a last resort.
rows.display_text:
「My power to fight lies in wit and
words. Resorting to violent force is only
for self-defense, or as a last resort.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: I see... I think I had the wrong idea about you.
rows.display_text:
「I see... I think I had the wrong idea
about you.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Actually, more like -- it seems like everyone has the wrong idea about you, Roger.
rows.display_text:
「Actually, more like -- it seems like
everyone has the wrong idea about you,
Roger.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That can't really be helped. It's true that, as a result, I've often ended up using Big O in the process of fulfilling a job.
rows.display_text:
「That can't be helped. As a result, I've
often ended up using Big O while carrying
out a job.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: But that's only when things end up in the kind of situation I just described.
rows.display_text:
「But that's only when things end up in
the kind of situation I just described.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: If people want to point at that and call me a troublemaker, I'll accept it without complaint.
rows.display_text:
「If people want to point at that and
call me a troublemaker, I'll accept it
without complaint.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Is that really okay...!? If you'd just explain properly, everyone would understand.
rows.display_text:
「Is that really okay...!? If you'd just
explain properly, everyone would
understand.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: If you leave the misunderstanding as is, it could end up like that fight between $c's two halves the other day.
rows.display_text:
「If you leave the misunderstanding as is,
it could end up like that fight between
$c's two halves the other day.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Mel... your feelings for $F are an illusion.
rows.display_text:
「Mel... your feelings for $F are an
illusion.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Huh!?
rows.display_text: 「Huh!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: You've simply mistaken the familiarity you feel for a man who's been by your side since childhood, for love.
rows.display_text:
「You've simply mistaken the familiarity
you feel for a man who's been by your
side since childhood, for love.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: This is what everyone in $c says.
rows.display_text: 「This is what everyone in $c says.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: That's not true...! It's just not true!
rows.display_text: 「That's not true...! It's just not true!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: It doesn't matter who says what! My feelings for Darling are the real thing!
rows.display_text:
「It doesn't matter who says what! My
feelings for Darling are the real thing!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That's exactly it.
rows.display_text: 「That's exactly it.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Huh!?
rows.display_text: 「Huh!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: No matter what others say, as long as you have something unshakable inside yourself, there's no need to waver.
rows.display_text:
「No matter what others say, as long as
you have something unshakable inside
yourself, there's no need to waver.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Roger...
rows.display_text: 「Roger...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: ...Listen, Mel. This conversation stays between us. Don't repeat what I've said today to anyone...
rows.display_text:
「...Listen, Mel. This conversation stays
between us. Don't repeat what I've said
today to anyone...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I want to confirm everything with my own eyes. That's why I left Paradigm City, and why I joined $c as well...
rows.display_text:
「I want to confirm everything with my
own eyes. That's why I left Paradigm
City, and why I joined $c as well...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Even ending up fighting the other half of $c -- I consider that part of the process of confirming the truth with my own eyes.
rows.display_text:
「Even fighting the other half of $c --
I consider that part of confirming the
truth with my own eyes.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: But that happened because someone tricked us -- both we and they were in the wrong.
rows.display_text:
「But that happened because someone
tricked us -- both we and they were in
the wrong.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: If my own thinking was mistaken, I simply admit the mistake and correct it.
rows.display_text:
「If my own thinking was mistaken, I
simply admit the mistake and correct it.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: As long as I have an unshakable sense of self, I have no need to be ashamed of either regret or rumor.
rows.display_text:
「As long as I have an unshakable sense
of self, I have no need to be ashamed of
either regret or rumor.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Whatever's true for $c as a whole, that's how it is for me personally, at least.
rows.display_text:
「Whatever's true for $c as a whole,
that's how it is for me personally, at
least.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Yeah... I understand, Roger.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah... I understand, Roger.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Mind you, I'm only human too. It's not as if misunderstandings don't hurt me at all.
rows.display_text:
「Mind you, I'm only human too. It's not
as if misunderstandings don't hurt me at
all.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: But I have someone who understands me. As long as there's someone who calls me Roger Smith, I remain Roger Smith.
rows.display_text:
「But I have someone who understands me.
As long as there's someone who calls me
Roger Smith, I remain Roger Smith.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Well, you do get jobs that name you specifically, so I guess the people who understand, understand.
rows.display_text:
「Well, you do get jobs that name you
specifically, so I guess the people who
understand, understand.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Now then, let's fulfill this job, Mel. Time to gather evidence of Este Corp's misdeeds.
rows.display_text:
「Now then, let's fulfill this job, Mel.
Time to gather evidence of Este Corp's
misdeeds.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Got it!
rows.display_text: 「Got it!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: From what I've heard around the city, Este is the kind of man who'll turn up plenty of dirt once you start digging. Gather that, and we'll win.
rows.display_text:
「From what I hear, Este's the kind of
man who'll turn up plenty of dirt once
you dig. Gather that, and we win.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: That's not gonna happen...!
rows.display_text: 「That's not gonna happen...!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: It's the thug from earlier!
rows.display_text: 「It's the thug from earlier!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: I was told to shut up the noisy crow that keeps cawing.
rows.display_text:
「I was told to shut up the noisy crow
that keeps cawing.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: No matter how much dirt you dig up, dead men tell no tales.
rows.display_text:
「No matter how much dirt you dig up,
dead men tell no tales.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Dirt turning up before I even start digging. Honestly... a villain's shallow thinking never fails to help me out.
rows.display_text:
「Dirt turning up before I even start
digging. Honestly... a villain's shallow
thinking never fails to help me out.」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: That smart mouth of yours ends here! Get ready!
rows.display_text:
「That smart mouth of yours ends here!
Get ready!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: R-Roger! Take those guys down!
rows.display_text: 「R-Roger! Take those guys down!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Unfortunately, it's my policy not to carry a gun.
rows.display_text:
「Unfortunately, it's my policy not to
carry a gun.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Then what are you gonna do!?
rows.display_text: 「Then what are you gonna do!?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: At times like this...
rows.display_text: 「At times like this...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: We run, Mel!!
rows.display_text: 「We run, Mel!!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: R-right!
rows.display_text: 「R-right!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Like hell we'll let you go! If that's how it is, we're taking this all the way!
rows.display_text:
「Like hell we'll let you go! If that's
how it is, we're taking this all the way!」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Thank you very much, Roger. I think the city will finally settle down now.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you very much, Roger. I think
the city will finally settle down now.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I've merely fulfilled my job. There's no need for thanks.
rows.display_text:
「I've merely fulfilled my job. There's no
need for thanks.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: But, for such a small fee...
rows.display_text: 「But, for such a small fee...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: As I told you yesterday. I don't choose my clients based on the size of their payment.
rows.display_text:
「As I told you yesterday. I don't choose
my clients based on the size of their
payment.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I simply found it distasteful that petty crooks would try to make your heartfelt garden their own.
rows.display_text:
「I simply found it distasteful that
petty crooks would try to make your
heartfelt garden their own.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Then please, accept this token of my feelings.
rows.display_text:
「Then please, accept this token of my
feelings.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Anemones... If I recall, their flower language is 'fleeting love'...
rows.display_text:
「Anemones... If I recall, their flower
language is 'fleeting love'...」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: Oh...? Anemones also carry the meaning 'anticipation,' you know.
rows.display_text:
「Oh...? Anemones also carry the meaning
'anticipation,' you know.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Is that so... It seems I was being a bit presumptuous.
rows.display_text:
「Is that so... It seems I was being a
bit presumptuous.」

rows.speaker: Citizen
rows.en: But this way, you'll be able to fulfill your first job after all.
rows.display_text:
「But this way, you'll be able to fulfill
your first job after all.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Forgive my rudeness, but if it's alright, might I ask for one more bundle of flowers?
rows.display_text:
「Forgive my rudeness, but if it's alright,
might I ask for one more bundle of
flowers?」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: ...Is the job finished, Roger?
rows.display_text: 「...Is the job finished, Roger?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Yes... I handed the requested item over to the messenger.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... I handed the requested item over
to the messenger.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: An item?
rows.display_text: 「An item?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: A present for a girl he's fond of, apparently. I was asked to procure it.
rows.display_text:
「A present for a girl he's fond of,
apparently. I was asked to procure it.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: I see.
rows.display_text: 「I see.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That... well, you know, Dorothy... I'm about to do something quite out of character for me.
rows.display_text:
「That... well, you know, Dorothy... I'm
about to do something quite out of
character for me.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Thank you, Dorothy. I'm always grateful for your support.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Dorothy. I'm always grateful
for your support.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Flowers...
rows.display_text: 「Flowers...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: The garden's owner pushed them on me. Since the timing's good, they're for you.
rows.display_text:
「The garden's owner pushed them on me.
Since the timing's good, they're for you.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: A present for a girl you're fond of? If that's what this is, I'm very happy, my beloved...
rows.display_text:
「A present for a girl you're fond of? If
that's what this is, I'm very happy, my
beloved...」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: R. Dorothy Wayneright...
rows.display_text: 「R. Dorothy Wayneright...」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: Just kidding.
rows.display_text: 「Just kidding.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: I-I see...
rows.display_text: 「I-I see...」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: I wanted to try making someone laugh, or making them happy, just like everyone else does.
rows.display_text:
「I wanted to try making someone laugh,
or making them happy, just like everyone
else does.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Forgive me for being so startled. Well then, as a matter of manners, a smile.
rows.display_text:
「Forgive me for being so startled. Well
then, as a matter of manners, a smile.」

rows.speaker: Dorothy
rows.en: But it's true that I was happy. Thank you, Roger.
rows.display_text:
「But it's true that I was happy. Thank
you, Roger.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: You're welcome, Dorothy.
rows.display_text: 「You're welcome, Dorothy.」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Now then... I wonder how things are going for him...
rows.display_text:
（Now then... I wonder how things are
going for him...）

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: ...I'm back, Anemone. I've just returned.
rows.display_text: 「...I'm back, Anemone. I've just returned.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: It was quite the tough mission. We crossed from southern Gallia Continent over to South Ameria, and I've just now gotten back.
rows.display_text:
「It was quite the tough mission. We
crossed from southern Gallia Continent to
South Ameria, and I just got back.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Operation Crusade was a success too, so it looks like things are about to get busy for us.
rows.display_text:
「Operation Crusade was a success too,
so it looks like things are about to get
busy for us.」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Anemone...
rows.display_text: 「Anemone...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Dewey... he never comes to see me at all. I've... been alone this whole time...
rows.display_text:
「Dewey... he never comes to see me at
all. I've... been alone this whole time...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The Colonel's just busy, so...
rows.display_text: 「The Colonel's just busy, so...」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: To the Colonel, I'm still nothing but a tool, after all...
rows.display_text:
「To the Colonel, I'm still nothing but a
tool, after all...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: You mustn't think things like that.
rows.display_text: 「You mustn't think things like that.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: I don't want to hear anything you have to say!
rows.display_text:
「I don't want to hear anything you have
to say!」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Oh, right... I brought you a souvenir. ...Here, this.
rows.display_text:
「Oh, right... I brought you a souvenir.
...Here, this.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Anemone flowers...
rows.display_text: 「Anemone flowers...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: I heard there was a flower with the same name as you, so I went looking for it.
rows.display_text:
「I heard there was a flower with the
same name as you, so I went looking for
it.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: The flower language of the anemone is 'vanishing hope'...
rows.display_text:
「The flower language of the anemone is
'vanishing hope'...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: If I fail, I'll surely be thrown away like an object... It suits exactly how I feel right now...
rows.display_text:
「If I fail, I'll surely be thrown away
like an object... It suits exactly how I
feel right now...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: That's not right, Anemone. The anemone's flower language is 'anticipation.'
rows.display_text:
「That's not right, Anemone. The
anemone's flower language is 'anticipation.'」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Dominic...
rows.display_text: 「Dominic...」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: The person who helped me find this flower told me that.
rows.display_text:
「The person who helped me find this
flower told me that.」

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: Anticipation... You... you have expectations for me?
rows.display_text:
「Anticipation... You... you have
expectations for me?」

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: It's not just me. The Colonel has expectations for you too.
rows.display_text:

rows.speaker: Anemone
rows.en: ...That's a surprisingly thoughtful present, coming from you...

rows.speaker: Dominic
rows.en: I'd do anything for you. Just to see you smile, I'd turn the whole world against me if I had to...

rows.en: I don't think of it as 'fleeting love.' I want to save you.
